scenarios.title: Evolve puts a +1/+1 counter when a creature with greater power or toughness enters
decisions: A casts Grizzly Bears, tapping Forest and Forest; it resolves.
If evolve triggers, both players pass and it resolves.

variants.label: greater_power_and_toughness
variants.expected: Evolve triggers: Grizzly Bears (2/2) is greater than Experiment One (1/1). Experiment One gets a +1/+1 counter and is 2/2.

variants.label: equal_stats
variants.delta: A casts Mons's Goblin Raiders (1/1), tapping Mountain, instead of Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: Mons's Goblin Raiders has neither greater power nor greater toughness than Experiment One, so evolve does not trigger. Experiment One stays 1/1.

variants.label: greater_toughness_only
variants.delta: A casts Wall of Wood (0/3), tapping Forest, instead of Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: Wall of Wood has greater toughness (3 > 1) but not greater power. Evolve triggers and Experiment One gets a +1/+1 counter, becoming 2/2.

scenarios.title: Each instance of evolve triggers separately
decisions: A casts Hill Giant, tapping four Mountains; it resolves.
Every evolve trigger goes on the stack; both players pass and each resolves in turn.

variants.label: two_instances
variants.expected: Experiment One has two instances of evolve (its own and the one granted by Tyranid Prime), so two triggers resolve. After the first, Experiment One is 2/2 and Hill Giant (3/3) is still greater, so the second also gives a counter: Experiment One has two +1/+1 counters and is 3/3. Tyranid Prime's own evolve gives it one counter (1/5).

variants.label: one_instance
variants.delta: Tyranid Prime is not on the battlefield, so Experiment One has only its own evolve.
variants.expected: One evolve trigger resolves. Experiment One gets one +1/+1 counter and is 2/2.

scenarios.forge_notes: Check that Forge keeps Experiment One's printed Evolve and the granted Evolve as two separate triggers.
